fix_text: Scope of the 40% clamp. The 40% limit of Law 1393 of 2010 art. 30 applies only to payments that would remunerate the service (salary in nature, Labour Code art. 127) but were agreed as excluded from the contribution base under Labour Code art. 128 and Law 344 of 1996 art. 17 — the WTC wage types marked 'Non-Salary - pacted'. Payments that are non-salary by their nature, because they do not remunerate the service — the transport allowance, occasional per diem, means and tools to do the job, work clothing and footwear (dotación), payments by mere liberality — never enter the contribution base, whatever their amount, and are not subject to the clamp (WTC 'Non-Salary - non-remunerative'). Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, sentencia de unificación rad. 05001-23-33-000-2016-02496-01 (25185), 9 December 2021, rule 3: "El pacto de 'desalarización' no puede exceder el límite previsto en el artículo 30 de la Ley 1393 de 2010, es decir, el 40% del total de la remuneración." The ruling does not define the 'total de la remuneración' against which the 40% is measured; UGPP's published guidance (2021, prior to the ruling) takes all salary and non-salary payments of the period, excluding the social benefits of CST titles VIII and IX, vacation pay and indemnities. Configure the denominator on that basis until UGPP or the Consejo de Estado says otherwise. Where the nature of a payment is unclear, it is treated as pacted and the Non-Salary Pact Flag in the DD decides.
reason: Core scope (clamp only for pacted payments; non-salary-by-nature payments outside the IBC) is confirmed by CE SU 25185 rules 1-3 and considerations; case number and date are correct (CE ficha + Senado note). Two defects: (1) the Spanish quote attributed to the ruling ('el límite del 40% será aplicable a los pagos que, siendo salariales, las partes deciden excluirlos de la base gravable, y no a los emolumentos que por disposición legal no son salariales') was not found in the CE ficha nor in the Senado unification note; the full ruling PDF (consejodeestado.gov.co/sentenciasu/cuarta/...25185...pdf) could not be downloaded this pass - replaced by the verified rule 3 text. (2) The claim that non-remunerative payments are 'not counted in the total remuneration against which the 40% is measured' is not stated in the ruling; the only UGPP guidance located (May 2021) counts all non-salary payments in 'total remunerado' except prestaciones sociales (titles VIII/IX), vacation pay and indemnities - so transport allowance, per diem, mere liberality would be IN the denominator. Claim removed. 'Connectivity allowance' and 'indemnities' dropped from the by-nature list for lack of a primary source read this pass (transport allowance out of the base per Ley 344/1996 art. 17, quoted in the ruling). Propagation: WTC V1 / Version Control D14 and DD W37 carry the same 'excluded from BOTH numerator and total remuneration' statement and need the same correction. To close the denominator point: full SU text or a post-2021 UGPP concept / Res. 1702/2021 protocol defining 'total de la remuneración'.
